chunks: And a prayer in it is equal to one hundred thousand prayers.

key_terms.أَلْفِ: thousand, completing the number of multiplied reward
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: salat (prayer), the act of ritual worship being discussed
key_terms.بِمِائَةِ: by one hundred, indicating the scale of multiplication
key_terms.صَلَاةٍ: prayers, the measure used for comparison in reward
key_terms.فِيهِ: in it, referring to the Sacred Mosque mentioned in context

ai.seo_question: What is the reward of performing salat in the Sacred Mosque?
ai.summary: This hadith states the immense merit of performing salat in the Sacred Mosque. It indicates that one prayer there carries the reward of one hundred thousand prayers elsewhere.
